Detailed Description

Memory object representation of a disk FITS file.

Constructors are provided to get FITS data from an existing file or to create new FITS data sets. Overloaded versions allow the user to read from one or more specified extensions; to read either just header information or the data on construction; and to specify scalar keyword values to be read on construction.

The Primary Header is created at construction.
